name: pH-sensing channels in sour taste
rationale: All members concern proton/pH-sensing cation and K2P channels and sour taste; unlike confusables it lacks other taste/olfactory modalities, CFTR anion transport and the remaining K2P channel families.

name: Hepatic glucose-6-phosphate turnover and glycogen regulation
rationale: Members cover glucose-6-phosphatase/transporter defects, glucokinase regulation and glycogen breakdown/synthesis control; distinct from glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogen storage disease and glucagon-PKA confusables by the G6P hydrolysis-transport and glucokinase axis.

name: Membrane glycerophospholipid and sphingolipid metabolism
rationale: Members span synthesis, acyl-chain remodelling, transfer and catabolism of glycerophospholipids plus sphingolipid/ceramide metabolism; the sphingolipid arm separates it from DAG/endocannabinoid and ether-lipid confusables.

qualifier: snoRNP/scaRNP assembly and Cajal body targeting
name: snoRNP and scaRNP assembly and Cajal body targeting
rationale: Members concern assembly and Cajal body localization of guide snoRNA/scaRNA particles and the rRNA/snRNA modifications they direct; confusables cover telomerase, rRNA processing, transcription and other RNA modification.

name: Epithelial hexose and urate transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are GLUT/SGLT hexose and SLC2A9/SLC22 urate transport and their disorders; urate handling separates it from carbohydrate digestion confusables and hexoses from amino acid transport confusables.

name: Neutral amino acid and oligopeptide membrane transport
rationale: Members concern SLC6/SLC36 and proton-coupled transport of neutral amino acids and di/oligopeptides and related transport disorders; distinct from cationic amino acid, cystine and urate transport confusables.

qualifier: cytolytic killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
name: Antimicrobial cytolytic killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members concern host killing and cytolysis of microbes, antifungal and anti-Gram-positive responses, metal sequestration and neutrophil cytotoxicity; antifungal and cytolytic content separates it from mucosal attachment, defensin and Gram-negative killing confusables.

name: HIV replication, APOBEC restriction and immunoglobulin diversification
rationale: Members cover HIV entry, reverse transcription and integration, APOBEC3G cytidine deaminase restriction and AID-driven immunoglobulin recombination, hypermutation and class switching; the B cell diversification and APOBEC arms separate it from HCMV/retroelement and ADAR editing confusables.

name: LDL receptor family lysosomal degradation and LDL clearance
rationale: Members describe LDLR/VLDLR internalisation and lysosomal degradation reducing LDL clearance, including LXR-induced limitation of cholesterol uptake; distinct from sterol-SREBP homeostasis and generic receptor internalization confusables.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and keratan sulfate glycosylation
rationale: Members cover DAG1 O-mannosyl/matriglycan synthesis and keratan sulfate synthesis/degradation with their congenital disorders; distinct from other GAG and muscle/basement membrane confusables.

qualifier: lung branching, trachea and alveolar cells
name: Lung and trachea morphogenesis and alveolar differentiation
rationale: Members cover lung branching, mesenchyme, saccule, vasculature and pneumocyte differentiation plus trachea and adjacent diaphragm development; distinct from salivary branching and surfactant confusables.

name: GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate-mannose donor synthesis
rationale: Members concern synthesis of GDP-mannose, dolichyl phosphate and dolichyl-phosphate mannose and the CDGs from their enzymes; distinct from ALG oligosaccharide assembly, GPI anchor and UDP-GlcNAc/sialic acid confusables.

name: Actin-driven dendrite arborization and filopodium regulation
rationale: Members regulate dendrite branching, spine and filopodium formation and postsynaptic actin via RHOF and EPHB signalling; distinct from BDNF/TRK and postsynaptic density assembly confusables.

qualifier: acyl remodelling, lipase hydrolysis and endocannabinoids
name: Glycerophospholipid remodelling, hydrolysis and endocannabinoid generation
rationale: Members cover phospholipid acyl-chain remodelling, lysophospholipid/DAG/MAG hydrolysis and N-acylethanolamine endocannabinoid signalling; distinct from de novo phospholipid/sphingolipid synthesis and PAF/ether lipid confusables.

name: N-glycan glucose and mannose trimming and processing
rationale: Members cover ER/Golgi N-glycan glucosidase and mannosidase trimming toward hybrid/complex glycans, Dol-P-glucose supply and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown; distinct from nucleotide sugar, sialylation and O-glycan confusables.

name: Glycerolipid synthesis and hormone-regulated triglyceride lipolysis
rationale: Members cover PA, DAG, MAG and TAG synthesis/remodelling and lipase-driven triglyceride breakdown including PDE3B signalling; distinct from lipid droplet and lipophagy confusables.

name: Endocardial cushion EMT, valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern endocardium, cushion EMT and fusion, valve and septum formation and great artery roots; distinct from myocardial/ventricular and neural crest outflow tract confusables.

name: Autophagosome assembly control and ER and nuclear autophagy
rationale: Members regulate phagophore/autophagosome assembly and maturation and include reticulophagy and nucleophagy; distinct from mitophagy, pexophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy confusables.

name: Lipase-mediated chylomicron and VLDL remodelling and clearance
rationale: Members cover LPL/hepatic lipase assembly and chylomicron/VLDL remodelling and clearance with their regulation; distinct from intestinal absorption, HDL/LDL remodelling and LXR lipogenesis confusables.

name: Histone and non-histone protein acetylation
rationale: Members concern lysine, N-terminal, histone and tubulin acetylation and its regulation; distinct from heat shock, chromatin remodelling and histone methylation confusables.

qualifier: dorsoventral patterning and motor neuron fate
name: Spinal cord dorsoventral patterning and motor neuron specification
rationale: Members concern dorsoventral neural tube patterning and specification, differentiation and migration of spinal motor neurons and interneurons; distinct from forebrain, cortical and early neural plate confusables.

name: Dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthesis and its glycosylation disorders
rationale: All members are dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthesis by the DPM1-3 complex and its CDGs; confusables cover GDP-mannose, dolichol and ALG oligosaccharide assembly steps.

qualifier: cytolysis and metal sequestration against fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
name: Cytolytic and metal-sequestering defense against fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members concern killing and cytolysis of microbes, metal sequestration, antifungal and anti-Gram-positive responses and neutrophil cytotoxicity; distinct from antimicrobial peptide production, respiratory burst, mucosal and defensin confusables.

qualifier: plasma membrane reuptake and vesicular loading
name: Dopamine and norepinephrine reuptake and vesicular loading
rationale: Members concern DAT/NET catecholamine uptake, monoamine transport and vesicular loading and their transporter disorders; distinct from dopamine receptor signalling, biosynthesis and secretion confusables.

name: Phosphate homeostasis and bone, tooth and ectopic mineralization
rationale: Members cover Na+/Pi transporters and their disorders, PTH and Klotho-FGFR control of phosphate, and bone, enamel, dentin and ectopic mineralization; distinct from vitamin D, odontogenesis and bicarbonate/anion transport confusables.
